Navier–Stokes Equations

The dynamics of an incompressible fluid are governed by:

$$ rac{\partial \mathbf{u}}{\partial t} + (\mathbf{u} \cdot abla)\mathbf{u} = - rac{1}{ ho} abla p + u abla^2\mathbf{u} + \mathbf{f} $$

Where $\mathbf{u}$ is velocity and $ ho$ the density.

designs.title: Google Clean Sting
designs.creator: studio
designs.prompt: Design a clean Google-style logo sting. White stage, generous whitespace, Product Sans-like geometric letterforms (use Arial with tight letter-spacing). Five dots (blue #4285F4, red #EA4335, yellow #FBBC05, green #34A853, one neutral gray) bounce in one by one with a soft overshoot, then settle into a horizontal row and morph-scale into the brand word "STUDIO" letter by letter. Below it, a thin gray subtitle "Animation Engine" fades up with letter-spacing easing from wide to normal. Everything completes by 2200ms with a calm, confident feel.

designs.title: Gradient Mesh Hero
designs.creator: studio
designs.prompt: Design a premium dark hero intro. Near-black stage (#050508) with four large blurred color blobs (magenta #ff0080, violet #7928ca, blue #0070f3, coral #ff4d4d) drifting slowly on independent sine paths with screen blend. Center: a frosted-glass card (rgba white 5%, 1px light border, backdrop blur look via layered rgba) containing a 72px bold title "Aura Pro" and a light 20px subtitle. The card scales from 0.9 and fades up in the first 500ms; blobs keep drifting forever so the clip never looks frozen.

designs.title: Kinetic Type Slam
designs.creator: studio
designs.prompt: Design a kinetic typography opener. The word "STUDIO" slams in letter by letter (90ms apart): each letter drops from above with heavy ease-out overshoot and a tiny 2px screen shake on landing. After the last letter (by 1100ms), a bold violet (#8b5cf6) underline sweeps left-to-right under the word in 400ms, then a small uppercase kicker "DESIGN FASTER" fades in above. Dark charcoal background (#111), white Helvetica-ish type, tight tracking, oversized scale.

designs.title: Social Lower Third
designs.creator: studio
designs.prompt: Design a broadcast lower-third. Bottom-left composition: a circular avatar (CORS-safe https image, white 4px ring) pops in with overshoot; a white rounded bar wipes out from behind it (clip-path left to right) carrying the name "ALEX WRIGHT" in bold dark slate; underneath, a blue "@alexwright" handle fades and slides up 10px. Sequence finishes by 1800ms and holds steady; subtle drop shadows, no background full-screen.

designs.title: Data Bars Reveal
designs.creator: studio
designs.prompt: Design a data-chart reveal on white. Header: tiny red uppercase eyebrow "THE NUMBERS" and a bold 27px two-line title. Six horizontal rows (Coal 35, Gas 23, Hydro 14, Nuclear 9, Wind 8, Solar 6) — each with a right-aligned label, a light-gray track and a colored bar (dark grays, teal, indigo, green, amber) that grows from 0 to its value with cubic ease-out, staggered 80ms apart, while a white % label inside each bar counts up in sync. All bars settled by 2000ms. Clean system-ui typography, 40/50px padding.

designs.title: Terminal Typing
designs.creator: studio
designs.prompt: Design a developer-terminal intro. Dark #0d1117 terminal card with a traffic-light header, monospace green-on-dark text. A prompt "~/studio ❯" appears, then the command "npx create-app@latest" types character by character (28ms/char) with a blinking block cursor. After typing (by ~1600ms) three output lines pop in staggered — "✓ deps installed", "✓ build passed", "➜ ready in 214ms" — each with a quick fade-slide. Subtle scanline texture optional; keep it crisp.

designs.title: Product Promo
designs.creator: studio
designs.prompt: Design an e-commerce product promo. Bold single-color stage (#e11d48), a large CORS-safe product image (a sneaker photo from images.unsplash.com) flies in from the right with rotation settling at -25°, then floats gently forever on a slow sine. Left side: huge condensed uppercase two-line headline slides in, a 24px subline fades after it, and a white pill price-chip "$189" pops with overshoot near the product. Finish the entrance by 1700ms; the float loop keeps it alive.

designs.title: Counter Stats
designs.creator: studio
designs.prompt: Design a minimalist stat counter. Near-white stage, centered composition: a small uppercase tracking-widest gray label "MONTHLY VISITORS" slides up and fades in first (300ms), then a giant 120px font-weight-800 number counts from 0 to 1,248,500 over 1400ms with strong ease-out (fast start, slow settle), using locale comma formatting. Beneath it a thin 4px indigo progress underline draws left-to-right in sync with the count. Ends clean and still.

designs.title: Quote Reveal
designs.creator: studio
designs.prompt: Design an elegant quote card. Warm paper background (#faf7f2), a huge decorative serif quotation mark (Playfair-like fallback Georgia) in soft terracotta fades in first, then the quote "Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication." reveals word by word (120ms apart) with gentle opacity and 8px rise, set in 34px Georgia italic dark slate. Attribution "— Leonardo da Vinci" fades in last with a short 40px rule line drawing beside it. Total 2200ms, museum-calm pacing.

designs.title: Neon Glitch Intro
designs.creator: studio
designs.prompt: Design a cyberpunk glitch intro. Black stage with faint scanlines (repeating-linear-gradient). The word "SYSTEM" in big monospace white flickers on, then runs three glitch bursts (at ~500ms, 900ms, 1300ms): each burst briefly offsets a red copy -6px left and a cyan copy 6px right (two absolutely-positioned clones) with clip-path slices jumping for 120ms, then snaps back. A small blinking cursor block and a corner tag "v2.0.1" complete it. All deterministic from time.

designs.title: Subscribe Outro
designs.creator: studio
designs.prompt: Design a YouTube-style outro. Soft dark gradient stage. Center: a white rounded "Subscribe" pill with red text pops in with overshoot; a hand-drawn-style cursor arrow (simple SVG) glides in and clicks it at 900ms — the pill squashes once (scaleY 0.85) and flips to "Subscribed ✓" in gray. A bell icon beside it rings (rotation wiggle 3 times) right after. Keep the cursor motion smooth with slight arc; finish by 2000ms and hold.

designs.title: Particle Constellation
designs.creator: studio
designs.prompt: Design a tech constellation intro. Deep navy (#0a0f1e) stage with ~40 small white dots (deterministic pseudo-random positions from index-based sines — no Math.random at module scope) drifting slowly; dots within 110px of each other connect with 1px rgba-white lines whose opacity scales with distance (compute pairs in onFrame). At 800ms a centered wordmark "CONSTELLATION" letter-spaced wide fades up with a soft glow (text-shadow). Loops gracefully forever.

designs.title: Travel Slideshow
designs.creator: studio
designs.prompt: Design a cinematic travel slideshow from FIVE different CORS-safe https://images.unsplash.com photos (use real photo IDs like photo-1506905925346-21bda4d32df4 — mountains, coast, city, desert, forest). Each photo is an object-fit:cover img filling the whole 800x450 stage. Sequence: each photo slowly scales 1.0 to 1.12 (Ken Burns, ease-linear) while crossfading to the next with a 900ms opacity overlap; every photo gets roughly duration/5 of screen time, all computed deterministically from time. Each slide gets a small uppercase letter-spaced location caption (bottom-left, e.g. DOLOMITES, ITALY) that slides up 14px and fades in 300ms after its photo appears, plus a thin bottom progress bar that fills continuously across the whole slideshow. Start the html block with <title>Travel Slideshow</title>.

designs.title: Math Lecture Scene
designs.creator: studio
designs.prompt: Design a math lecture scene using KaTeX. Put the three KaTeX CDN tags (css2 stylesheet URL for katex.min.css, then katex.min.js, then contrib/auto-render.min.js from cdn.jsdelivr.net) at the top of the html block, with a hidden div containing $$ a^2 + b^2 = c^2 $$ that auto-render converts on first frame. Warm paper background (#fbfaf8), serif card with soft shadow. Choreography: card fades in (0-400ms); an SVG curved arrow (absolutely positioned overlay, marker arrowhead) draws itself pointing at the b^2 term using stroke-dashoffset animated in onFrame (500-1100ms); then a 3px amber underline sweeps left-to-right under the c^2 term (1200-1600ms, approximate the position with percentages); finally an italic annotation "Pythagoras, c. 500 BC" fades up beside the card (1800-2200ms). Keep every motion deterministic from time. Start the html block with <title>Pythagoras Proof</title>.

designs.title: Blog Post Reveal
designs.creator: studio
designs.prompt: Design an MDX blog-post preview. Include the marked CDN script tag (cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/marked/marked.min.js) in the html block and hide the raw markdown inside a display:none div: a post title, subtitle, one paragraph, and three bullet takeaways. On first frame run marked.parse on the unescaped source (unescape & < > exactly like the MDX Report preset does) into a styled article card: white paper, max-width 620px centered, subtle shadow, colored top bar reading engineering.blog. Choreography: top bar slides down (0-350ms), h1 fades up with slight rise, then subtitle, paragraph and each list item cascade in 120ms apart with a 24px rise and cubic ease-out; a small reading-time chip (6 min read) pops with overshoot at the end. All state from onFrame(time). Start the html block with <title>Blog Post Reveal</title>.

Dark slate-950 stage containing: a top navbar (gradient logo dot, three fake nav links, rounded avatar circle), a hero row with heading "Ship your side project", a muted subline and two buttons (one gradient, one outline), and a grid of three stat cards (Revenue $12.4k, Users 8,102, Churn 1.8%) each with a mini sparkline built from 8-10 colored rounded div bars. Choreography in onFrame: navbar drops in (0-300ms), hero elements stagger-fade-up (200-800ms), stat cards flip up from rotateX(90deg) staggered 150ms, sparkline bars grow bottom-up staggered 40ms, then the whole card group gently floats on ±3px sines with different phases. Start the html block with <title>SaaS Dashboard Teaser</title>.

designs.title: Editorial Serif Intro
designs.creator: studio
designs.prompt: Design a fashion-magazine cover reveal using two Google Fonts. Put this link tag at the top of the html block: <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,wght@0,300;0,900;1,400&family=Inter:wght@300;400;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">. Ivory paper stage (#f5f1e8). Centerpiece: the masthead ATELIER in Fraunces weight 900 at 130px, revealed by a clip-path wipe top-to-bottom (0-900ms) while its letter-spacing eases from 40px down to normal. Above it a tiny Inter uppercase issue tag "ISSUE 04 — THE DESIGN ANNUAL", letter-spaced wide, fades in first (0-400ms). Two hairline rules (1px near-black) sweep outward from the masthead center (600-1200ms). Then three cover lines set in Inter 300 (Silk & Static, The New Minimalism, 12 Pages of Type) rise gently one by one (1400-2600ms, 20px rise, cubic ease-out). An italic Fraunces ampersand ornament rotates slightly into the bottom corner last (2800-3400ms) and everything holds perfectly still — magazine-calm pacing, no bounce anywhere. Start the html block with <title>Editorial Serif Intro</title>.

designs.title: Mono Manifesto
designs.creator: studio
designs.prompt: Design a typographic manifesto using two Google Fonts. Put this link tag at the top of the html block: <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">. Deep ink stage (#0e1116) with a very subtle vertical grain. Four manifesto lines set in Space Grotesk 500 at 28px fade up and slide 16px one at a time, 700ms apart, each with a small monospace index tick (01, 02, 03, 04 in JetBrains Mono, amber #f59e0b) sliding in beside it: We believe tools disappear. / Craft is a habit, not a gift. / Details are the design. / Ship it beautiful. Right after each line lands, one keyword in it (tools, habit, Details, beautiful) crossfades to amber over 150ms. A thin 2px baseline underline then draws left-to-right under the whole stanza (400ms) and a JetBrains Mono cursor block blinks exactly twice. Total choreography about 5600ms; everything reads calm, smooth and precise. Start the html block with <title>Mono Manifesto</title>.

designs.title: Derivation Steps
designs.creator: studio
designs.prompt: Design a step-by-step math derivation using KaTeX. Put the three KaTeX CDN tags at the top of the html block (css2 stylesheet URL for katex.min.css, then katex.min.js, then contrib/auto-render.min.js from cdn.jsdelivr.net), with each equation as a hidden $$...$$ div that auto-render converts on first frame. Off-white paper stage (#fafaf7), a soft serif header reading Solving the Quadratic, and a roomy card holding three left-aligned equation rows: 1) $$ x^2 - 5x + 6 = 0 $$, 2) $$ (x - 2)(x - 3) = 0 $$, 3) $$ x = 2 \quad \text{or} \quad x = 3 $$. Each row slides in from 24px with fade (cubic ease-out), 900ms apart, while a small rounded step-number chip (1, 2, 3) pops with slight overshoot beside it. After the last row, a 2px indigo rounded border draws itself around row three (use a wrapping div whose width/height reveal via clip-path inset sweep, 500ms) and a small green SVG check mark pops beside it. Deterministic from time only; about 4600ms of choreography then a clean hold. Start the html block with <title>Derivation Steps</title>.

designs.title: Stat Board Tailwind
designs.creator: studio
designs.prompt: Design a quarterly KPI board using ONLY Tailwind utility classes for layout and visuals (flex, grid, gap, rounded-2xl, ring-1 ring-white/10, bg-gradient-to-br from-violet-600 to-indigo-600, text-slate-300, backdrop-blur — the v4 runtime compiles them automatically). Dark slate-950 stage. Structure: a slim gradient header bar with a white dot logo and the title Q3 Performance; below it a 2x2 grid of four stat cards — Revenue $48.2k (+12.4%), Active Users 9,041 (+8.1%), NPS 61 (+5), Uptime 99.98% (+0.02%) — each with a slate-800 background, small uppercase slate-400 label, huge white number, a green delta chip, and a mini gauge built from 10 rounded div bars whose filled count matches the stat. Choreography in onFrame: header drops in (0-300ms), cards rise staggered 180ms apart with a 20px fade-up, numbers count up from 0 over 1200ms with strong ease-out synced to their card landing, gauge bars fill left-to-right staggered 50ms, delta chips pop with overshoot last; then the whole board floats on a slow ±3px sine with per-card phase offsets so it never looks frozen. Generous padding, clean spacing. Start the html block with <title>Stat Board Tailwind</title>.

designs.title: Lyric Subtitle Flow
designs.creator: studio
designs.prompt: Design a karaoke-style subtitle animation, clean and highly readable. Load the Inter font with this link tag at the top of the html block: <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">. Stage background: a soft dark diagonal gradient (#111827 to #1f2937) so the caption reads like video subtitles over footage. A lower-third caption card (max-width 640px, horizontally centered, 40px from bottom): rounded-xl, rgba(0,0,0,0.55) background, white Inter 26px text, subtle shadow. Three subtitle lines play in sequence, each visible about 2200ms: The studio renders every frame. / Each word lights up as it is sung. / Clean, smooth, easy to read. Per line: the full sentence fades in fast (200ms); then each word in turn brightens from rgba(255,255,255,0.45) to pure white using a left-to-right fill sweep — implement with a second absolutely-positioned white copy of the word clipped by an inset() whose right edge sweeps across, driven deterministically from time — roughly 260ms per word staggered; after the last word the whole line crossfades out (300ms) as the next fades in. A tiny 4px violet underline scales under the currently-sung word via transform scaleX. All timing from per-word time windows inside onFrame(time). Start the html block with <title>Lyric Subtitle Flow</title>.

designs.title: Font Pairing Showcase
designs.creator: studio
designs.prompt: Design a typographic specimen that cycles through three font pairings, mixing Tailwind utilities and Google Fonts. Put this link tag at the top of the html block: <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,700;1,400&family=Inter:wght@300;400;600&family=DM+Serif+Display&family=Space+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">. Use Tailwind utilities for all layout (flex, grid, tracking-widest, rounded-2xl, ring-1 ring-slate-200, bg-white shadow-xl) on a light slate-100 stage. Center: a specimen card (700x360) with a small uppercase slate-500 kicker (PAIRING 01/03, updating per scene), a huge headline, a short body paragraph and a caption chip. Three scenes, each ~2000ms with a 300ms crossfade — Scene 1: headline in Playfair Display 700 reading Serif voice, body Inter 300; Scene 2: headline in DM Serif Display reading Display calm, body Space Mono 400, card tinted stone-50; Scene 3: headline in Inter 600 tight reading Sans modern, caption chip in Space Mono. Transitions: the outgoing headline blurs up (filter blur 0 to 6px, translateY -12px, fade out) while the incoming one blurs down into place; the kicker crossfades; a 3-dot progress indicator fills one segment per scene. Deterministic from time only. Start the html block with <title>Font Pairing Showcase</title>.
